summary: An overview of recent technology developments, focusing on advancements in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and accessibility.

items.title: AfterQuery reportedly becomes Y Combinator’s fastest-ever unicorn, now valued at $3.2B
items.summary: AI model-training startup AfterQuery has reportedly reached a $3.2 billion valuation just five months after its Series A. This rapid growth highlights the intense investor demand and massive scale of modern artificial intelligence development tools.

items.title: OpenAI’s Astra model is on the way — and very good at breaking into computer systems
items.summary: OpenAI has previewed Astra, its upcoming cyber-critical large language model that demonstrates advanced capabilities in breaking into computer systems. The preview highlights the safety precautions being implemented to mitigate potential cybersecurity risks before its release.

items.title: Google’s Android update tackles motion sickness, accessibility, and more
items.summary: Google's latest Android update introduces new features leveraging Gemini AI to improve accessibility and address issues like motion sickness. These updates help close the feature gap with competitors while enhancing the overall user experience.

items.title: BGP hijack infecting networks caused by a comedy of errors that’s not funny at all
items.summary: A well-executed BGP hijacking attack successfully poisoned production software by using hijacked IP addresses to infect real networks. The incident serves as a critical warning about the vulnerabilities in global routing infrastructure and the importance of network security.

items.title: Microsoft is enabling a Windows 11 security feature that can hurt gaming performance
items.summary: Microsoft is rolling out a kernel-level memory integrity security feature to more Windows 11 devices to block malicious code. While the update significantly enhances system security, it may negatively impact PC gaming performance.
